rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese equivalent for a previously mentioned group.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ngaam1 ngaam1 zau2 zo2

rows.note: Use this for one previously mentioned person when gender is unspecified or irrelevant.

example.english: I don't know who called, but they still haven't replied to me.
example.traditional: 我唔知邊個打嚟，但佢仲未覆我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 bin1 go3 daa2 lai4 daan6 keoi5 zung6 mei6 fuk1 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for unspecified or other people generally, especially in expressions such as 人哋話.

example.english: They say the food at this shop is good.
example.traditional: 人哋話呢間舖頭啲嘢好食。
example.jyutping: jan4 dei6 waa6 ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 di1 je5 hou2 sik6
